title: 复盘可口可乐 2025 Share a Coke：怎样打动新一代顾客？
topic: 依据可口可乐 2025 年公告，说明 Z 世代洞察、包装与数字体验组合及全球推广计划

source.title: Iconic ‘Share a Coke’ is Back for a New Generation
source.section: Coca-Cola 全球品牌活动介绍
source.type: Coca-Cola 全球品牌活动介绍
source.context: 一瓶印着名字的可乐，怎样变成全球营销活动？
paragraphs: Now, Share a Coke is making a timely comeback in 2025 as Gen Z seeks authentic connection in an increasingly digital world. Share a Coke will encourage this audience to tap into the nostalgia of personalizing a can of Coca-Cola as a creative way to show their friends, loved ones and community that they see them — a reminder that all it takes to spark a connection is a simple act of sharing.

The 2025 iteration of the groundbreaking campaign fuses digital and IRL experiences with increased shareability and customization. Starting in April, consumers will begin finding Coca-Cola cans or bottles with names on store shelves. The rolling global launch will ultimately include 120+ countries.

The Coca-Cola mobile app and on-pack QR codes provide a gateway to the Share a Coke digital hub, where fans can customize Coca-Cola packaging with additional names and access the “Share a Coke Memory Maker,” an interactive digital experience to create personalized videos with their own content and memes to share with friends — all in the spirit of celebrating friendships by turning everyday moments into lasting, shareable memories.
translations: 2025 年，“分享一瓶可乐”活动适时回归，面向在数字化世界中寻求真实联结的 Z 世代。活动通过个性化包装唤起怀旧感，让人们借分享表达对朋友、家人和社区的关心。
新版活动把数字体验和线下体验结合起来，并增加了分享和定制方式。从 4 月开始，消费者会在货架上看到印有名字的可口可乐包装；全球分阶段推广最终将覆盖 120 多个国家。
可口可乐 App 和包装上的二维码将消费者带到活动数字平台。消费者可以定制包装，也可以用自己的内容制作个性化视频并分享给朋友。
fullTextParagraphs: In 2011, Coca-Cola Australia launched what became an iconic marketing campaign. Share a Coke made an impact on a global scale with a simple creative idea — turning Coca-Cola bottles and cans into personalized keepsakes by swapping out the logo with popular first names — that encouraged fans to connect and make memories with friends and loved ones.

Now, Share a Coke is making a timely comeback in 2025 as Gen Z seeks authentic connection in an increasingly digital world. Share a Coke will encourage this audience to tap into the nostalgia of personalizing a can of Coca-Cola as a creative way to show their friends, loved ones and community that they see them — a reminder that all it takes to spark a connection is a simple act of sharing.

The 2025 iteration of the groundbreaking campaign fuses digital and IRL experiences with increased shareability and customization. Starting in April, consumers will begin finding Coca-Cola cans or bottles with names on store shelves. The rolling global launch will ultimately include 120+ countries.

The Coca-Cola mobile app and on-pack QR codes provide a gateway to the Share a Coke digital hub, where fans can customize Coca-Cola packaging with additional names and access the “Share a Coke Memory Maker,” an interactive digital experience to create personalized videos with their own content and memes to share with friends — all in the spirit of celebrating friendships by turning everyday moments into lasting, shareable memories.

Other Share a Coke elements include “The Magic of Sharing” film, partnering with influencers to reach Gen Z on relevant social platforms, striking outdoor creative highlighting the energy and excitement of friendship, “Share a Meal” bundles at McDonald’s restaurants in select countries, and more.
“The iconic Share a Coke is back and supercharged at a global level, celebrating the pure magic that happens when people connect,” said Islam ElDessouky, Global VP, Creative at Coca-Cola.

As digital natives, Gen Z’s digital interactions can feel fleeting, fueling a desire for real-life engagement. As Gen Z seeks authenticity and connection with people in real life in a world where interactions online can feel momentary, sharing a Coke offers a tangible way to show you care.
“It’s not just about likes and shares… we’re talking real-world moments, amplified,” said ElDessouky.

Share a Coke honors the friendships and online experiences that define this generation, as well as the physical spaces that allow moments of togetherness to thrive through spontaneous moments of laughter, stories and fun.

“Get ready for a whole new level of sharing with fresh experiences and ways to spark joy with your crew. We’re bringing new channels and experiences to this campaign to help people uplift friendships through real-life everyday moments,” said ElDessouky.

scenario.title: 练习情境（虚构）：向区域团队介绍一场品牌活动
english: A coffee brand wants to bring back a popular seasonal campaign for younger customers.
The plan combines limited-edition cups in stores, personalized videos in the app and local creator partnerships.
The launch will roll out across 35 markets, with each team choosing local names and social content. Write three sentences for regional marketers.
chinese: 一家咖啡品牌希望为年轻顾客重启一项受欢迎的季节性活动。
计划把门店限量杯、App 个性化视频和本地创作者合作结合起来。
活动将分阶段覆盖 35 个市场，由各地团队选择当地名字和社交内容。请给区域营销人员写三句话。

firstAttempt.prompt: 给区域营销团队写三句话：根据可口可乐 2025 年 3 月 26 日公告，说明活动面向新一代消费者的洞察，介绍包装与数字体验如何结合，再交代当时计划的全球推广范围。
firstAttempt.sample: In its March 2025 announcement, Coca-Cola said Share a Coke would return for Gen Z, who were seeking authentic connections in an increasingly digital world. The campaign paired personalized packaging with app and QR-code access to a digital hub and Memory Maker videos. The phased rollout was planned to reach more than 120 countries.
firstAttempt.rationale: 标明公告日期后，先归纳品牌对 Z 世代的洞察，再说明包装、App/二维码和视频体验，最后将 120 多个国家标为公告中的计划范围。

words.translation: 公司将分阶段推广这场活动。

words.example: The campaign is designed to create an authentic connection with customers.
words.translation: 这场活动旨在与顾客建立真实联结。

output.prompt: 练习迁移（虚构饮料品牌）：一家饮料品牌希望重新推出一款经典夏季饮品。调查显示，年轻顾客想要更有参与感的线下体验。计划通过门店定制杯、App 短视频和音乐节摊位推广，先在 18 个市场推出。请写三句话给区域营销团队，说明洞察、推广组合和推出范围。
